package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for mapper_outside_mapper_package_when_repo_uses_mappers: Mapper functions scattered across handlers and services when the repo already has a dedicated mapping package.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type OrderDB struct {
	ID       int
	UserID   int
	Amount   float64
	ItemName string
}

type OrderResponse struct {
	OrderID  int     `json:"order_id"`
	UserName string  `json:"user_name"`
	Total    float64 `json:"total"`
	Item     string  `json:"item"`
}

func mapOrderToResponse(o *OrderDB) OrderResponse {
	return OrderResponse{
		OrderID:  o.ID,
		UserName: "",
		Total:    o.Amount,
		Item:     o.ItemName,
	}
}

func GetOrderHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	record := &OrderDB{ID: 101, UserID: 5, Amount: 49.99, ItemName: "Laptop"}

	resp := mapOrderToResponse(record)

	json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(resp)
}
